overview: Core reading works without JavaScript, and sampled text assets use compression. Correct the ecosystem emissions figures and make open pages follow device-theme changes. Investigate overflow, image readability and monitoring thresholds before choosing fixes. The score covers selected checks on three pages and reflects missing evidence as well as problems. Some transferred data could not be measured, so page sizes are incomplete and carbon ratings were not calculated. The supplied source has not been matched to the live deployment.
nextSteps: Trace the ecosystem emissions figures to their source and reconcile the total, site count, average and reporting period.
Retest device-theme changes on all three pages, both with and without a manual theme choice.
Complete the Sustainability footer journey at 360 pixels wide and using only the keyboard; inspect overflow and focus visibility.
Verify stored cookie choices and subsequent tracking, then inspect print previews and image readability.
Obtain the deployed revision, lockfile contents, monitoring threshold and response procedure, release notes, and licensing and contribution guidance.
Repeat first-load measurements with unresolved transfers accounted for before calculating carbon ratings.

findings.title: Reconcile the ecosystem emissions figures
findings.summary: The Sustainability page reports 5,173 tons of CO2e a year across 6,431 sites alongside an average of 12 tons per site a year. These figures cannot describe the same population and average. The separate homepage estimate has a clearer date and method.
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot reliably interpret the ecosystem estimate when its total, site count and average contradict one another.
findings.action: Check the underlying analysis and correct or explain the population, statistic and period for each figure. Keep ecosystem estimates clearly separate from this website's estimate.

findings.title: Follow device-theme changes while pages are open
findings.summary: All three pages open with a dark palette when the device already uses dark mode. Changing the device to dark mode while a page is open leaves its light palette in place. Reading content remains available.
findings.whyItMatters: Visitors who change their device theme do not receive the same response as visitors who open the page with that preference already set.
findings.action: Confirm how manual theme choices should take precedence, then correct device-theme handling when no manual override exists. Verify changes in both directions on all three pages, keeping initial dark mode and the manual switch working.

findings.title: Check whether overflow affects reading and navigation
findings.summary: Every sampled page extends 10 pixels beyond both the 1,280-pixel and 360-pixel viewport widths. Reading text remains available, but the effect of that overflow is unresolved and mobile controls were not exercised.
findings.whyItMatters: If useful content extends off-screen, visitors may need horizontal scrolling to read or reach controls.
findings.action: Locate the element causing the extra width and complete the Sustainability footer journey at 360 pixels. Establish whether content or controls are affected before choosing a fix.

findings.title: Check image readability before changing sizes
findings.summary: The Sustainability chart is a 1,300-pixel-wide WebP displayed at 660 pixels on desktop, while some smaller images are enlarged. Dimensions alone do not establish excessive delivery or adequate readability.
findings.whyItMatters: Image size decisions need to balance transferred data with readable chart labels and useful detail.
findings.action: Compare the chart and enlarged images at narrow and desktop widths, including intended pixel densities. Assess smaller versions only where they retain useful detail. Test video activation before proposing changes to when it loads.

findings.title: Check the page-size alert threshold and response
findings.summary: Digital emissions describes weekly monitoring and page-size alerts. The supplied page and project files do not state the threshold or what happens when it is exceeded; this does not establish that either is missing.
findings.whyItMatters: A concrete limit and response procedure let maintainers verify that monitoring catches unwanted page growth.
findings.action: Obtain the configured threshold and document who responds to an alert and what they do. Verify the alert behavior. If no limit exists, agree one based on the pages visitors need and test its enforcement.

checks.title: Check whether prompts interrupt reading
checks.summary: An event promotion and cookie prompt accompany the reading content. Recorded dialogs are hidden and the homepage video does not autoplay, but the prompts' visual disruption remains unclear.
checks.nextStep: Inspect the initial view and dismiss prompts while completing the sustainability reading task.

checks.title: Check that cookie choices work as presented
checks.summary: The prompt explains measurement and offers equally sized Opt in and Opt out buttons. Both choices were clicked on all three pages, but visual prominence, saved choices and subsequent tracking remain unverified.
checks.nextStep: Compare button appearance, reload after each choice, and verify stored consent and tracking behavior.

checks.title: Correct the contradictory emissions wording
checks.summary: The Sustainability page's annual total, site count and stated average cannot describe the same population. Digital emissions more clearly separates the homepage estimate, its April 2026 date and its method.
checks.nextStep: Trace the ecosystem figures to their source and reconcile their population, statistic and period.

checks.title: Keep navigation names consistent
checks.summary: The three pages repeat the same main navigation names, Get started label and search-control name. This supports consistency in the sampled controls.
checks.nextStep: Open the navigation controls on each page and compare their labels and behavior.

checks.title: Check animation behavior with reduced motion
checks.summary: Animations were recorded on the homepage and Sustainability page with reduced motion enabled, but their purpose and visible effect are unknown. The homepage video has playback controls and does not autoplay.
checks.nextStep: Identify which properties animate and observe whether their reduced-motion behavior suits their purpose.

checks.title: Keep notifications under visitor control
checks.summary: No notification permission requests were recorded, and newsletter signup is optional. Browser notification permission was already denied, so behavior before a visitor makes that choice remains unchecked.
checks.nextStep: Repeat the reading journey with notification permission unset.

checks.title: Check printed pages for usable output
checks.summary: Print emulation retains reading text and hides navigation. Page breaks and chart clipping have not been checked, and no downloadable document was inspected.
checks.nextStep: Inspect print previews of Sustainability and Digital emissions for readable content, intact charts and sensible pagination.

checks.title: Check code use beyond the first load
checks.summary: The brief first-load recording includes code that had not run. That does not establish it can be removed: navigation, search, cookie choices and media may need it later.
checks.nextStep: Extend code-use recording through those interactions before selecting anything for removal.

checks.title: Check whether search code can load later
checks.summary: The main script loads initially, and the supplied search code opens a dialog on click. Its contribution to the live script and its behavior when loaded later have not been established.
checks.nextStep: Identify the search code within the delivered script, exercise search, then compare a version that loads it on demand.

checks.title: Investigate the extra page width
checks.summary: All three pages exceed desktop and narrow viewport widths by 10 pixels. Narrow views retain reading text and expose mobile controls, but their usability and the overflow's effect remain unresolved.
checks.nextStep: Find the overflowing element and complete the Sustainability footer journey at 360 pixels wide.

checks.title: Check information offered before video playback
checks.summary: The homepage offers optional video and a theme switch, and Sustainability explains an OLED-related dark-mode benefit. Whether visitors receive useful information when deciding to play the video remains unclear.
checks.nextStep: Inspect the playback context for duration, data expectations and a useful reading alternative.

checks.title: Keep the footer route to Sustainability working
checks.summary: Clicking the homepage footer's Sustainability link successfully opened the expected page and heading. This confirms the tested route works.
checks.nextStep: Complete the same journey using only the keyboard.

checks.title: Check chart and image quality at intended sizes
checks.summary: The Sustainability chart is delivered as a 1,300-pixel WebP and displayed at 660 pixels on desktop; some smaller images are enlarged. Readability and suitable delivery sizes remain unverified.
checks.nextStep: Compare chart labels and image detail at narrow and desktop sizes and intended pixel densities.

checks.title: Check readability when fonts cannot load
checks.summary: Two Kumbh Sans weights load, and a generic sans-serif fallback is declared. Readability during delayed or failed font loading and support for required languages remain unchecked.
checks.nextStep: Delay or block font responses and verify that task text stays readable, including required language characters.

checks.title: Check primary headings and control names
checks.summary: Each page declares English, one main content area and one primary heading, and recorded controls have naming information. The captured heading lists stop before the primary heading, leaving its wording and meaning unverified.
checks.nextStep: Inspect each primary heading and main content area, then verify names for dialogs after opening them.

checks.title: Keep page titles and canonical links useful
checks.summary: All three pages have descriptive titles and canonical links to their own HTTPS URLs. The homepage's structured data parses as JSON; its vocabulary has not been validated.
checks.nextStep: Validate the homepage's structured data against its intended vocabulary if it will be reused.

checks.title: Update the theme when device preferences change
checks.summary: Dark mode works when pages open with that device preference already set. Switching to dark mode while any sampled page is open leaves the light palette, although reading content remains available.
checks.nextStep: Correct and retest theme changes without a manual override, then verify that explicit visitor choices take precedence.

checks.title: Keep core reading available without JavaScript
checks.summary: The homepage introduction, sustainability commitments, emissions method and navigation text remain available with JavaScript disabled. Search and other interactive behavior were not established.
checks.nextStep: Follow the Sustainability link with JavaScript disabled to verify the reading journey.

checks.title: Check the purpose of repeated analytics requests
checks.summary: First-load records include a site-alert request and several analytics pageview requests to different destinations. Their purposes and longer-term behavior are unclear; similar requests alone do not establish duplication.
checks.nextStep: Document each analytics destination's purpose and observe requests after cookie choices and while the page is idle.

checks.title: Verify that repeat visits reuse static files
checks.summary: Sampled versioned scripts, styles and fonts declare long-lived public caching with validation information. These settings support reuse, but actual browser reuse and offline operation were not measured.
checks.nextStep: Revisit the pages with a populated browser cache and verify that intended files are reused.

checks.title: Keep text compression enabled
checks.summary: Successful page HTML responses use Brotli compression, while the main stylesheet and scripts use gzip. The sampled substantial text assets therefore have compression enabled.
checks.nextStep: Verify that compression remains enabled after the next asset deployment.

checks.title: Check that keyboard focus is easy to see
checks.summary: The recorded Tab sequence reaches navigation, search and task links in a meaningful order and reports focus outlines. Whether those indicators are visually clear has not been established.
checks.nextStep: Observe focus on the skip link, navigation and search control, then complete the reading journey using the keyboard.

checks.title: Support the published sustainability account
checks.summary: Sustainability explicitly includes wagtail.org, and Digital emissions explains the homepage estimate's date, method and monitoring approach. The statements cover this website, but their reported quantities and implementation were not verified.
checks.nextStep: Obtain the underlying measurement and monitoring records supporting the published claims.

checks.title: Keep carbon.txt declarations usable and current
checks.summary: The root carbon.txt was retrieved without redirects and parsed, with usable disclosure links. It declares version 0.4; schema validity remains unchecked, and the expired 2023 and 2024 declarations remain historical evidence.
checks.nextStep: Validate against the authoritative version-specific schema and review the historical declarations' validity annotations.

checks.title: Check evidence behind hosting claims
checks.summary: The site declares Cloudflare, Heroku, AWS and GitHub service relationships. Those declarations do not independently establish the current infrastructure serving wagtail.org or its environmental performance.
checks.nextStep: Obtain infrastructure records linking each service to this website and current provider energy evidence for those services.

checks.title: Retain shared navigation and interface components
checks.summary: The supplied templates reuse the same navigation implementation for desktop and mobile, alongside shared skip-link, search and SVG components. This supports reuse in the inspected interface code.
checks.nextStep: Inspect the shared navigation implementation before proposing consolidation or replacement.

checks.title: Check that dependency versions can be reproduced
checks.summary: Dependency lists are available, but the captured lockfiles expose only file details rather than resolved versions. A compatible, repeatable installation has not been verified.
checks.nextStep: Inspect lockfile headers and resolved dependency entries, then verify an installation using the locked versions.

checks.title: Keep runtime declarations aligned
checks.summary: Python 3.14, Node 24 and Poetry 2.4.0 declarations agree across the relevant build and test files. This establishes declaration consistency without establishing latest-release status.
checks.nextStep: Compare the declarations with production runtime versions; obtain authoritative release references before making a latest-version claim.

checks.title: Verify cancellation of superseded test runs
checks.summary: The test workflow is configured to cancel superseded runs and reuse dependency caches, with test jobs following linting. These controls support the scoped automation check.
checks.nextStep: Inspect a superseded run to verify cancellation, and review lint configuration before proposing fewer validation steps.

checks.title: Keep maintenance instructions usable
checks.summary: The project guide explains setup, migrations, caching, frontend builds, linting and deployment. The test configuration also documents application checks and tests.
checks.nextStep: Verify the documented commands against a current maintainer's setup and maintenance workflow.

checks.title: Locate useful change information for users
checks.summary: The requested changelog was unavailable, and the supplied project guide explains development rather than versioned user-facing changes. Release notes may exist elsewhere.
checks.nextStep: Provide the release notes or equivalent history that explains relevant changes to affected users.

checks.title: Identify the monitoring limit and response
checks.summary: Digital emissions describes weekly monitoring and alerts, but the supplied page and build files do not identify a concrete page-size limit or response procedure. Their existence remains unresolved.
checks.nextStep: Provide the configured threshold, alert or build-failure behavior, and instructions for responding to an exceedance.

checks.title: Clarify reuse terms and contribution guidance
checks.summary: The Python and JavaScript manifests name BSD-3-Clause and ISC licenses respectively. The supplied files do not resolve their scope or establish the contribution procedure.
checks.nextStep: Inspect the applicable license and contribution documents, clarifying which terms cover code and site content.
